Method of Attack: Local port scan of 14 different ports on the visitor's computer to detect remote support and remote access applications
Uses WebSockets to connect to 127.0.0.1 on specified ports
Impacted Systems: Windows computers running remote access tools such as Windows Remote Desktop, VNC, TeamViewer, Ammy Admin, Aeroadmin, Anyplace Control, AnyDesk
Attack Vector: Script running on eBay.com website during visit
